issues.detail: The Hebrew 'נָשִׂיא' means 'leader/prince', not '元帥' (military commander/marshal). This changes the role of the person.

The Hebrew 'אֲחִיהוּד' is a personal name 'Ahihud', but the Chinese renders it as '亞希戶德人' adding '人' (person/people), which incorrectly implies a gentilic or ethnic designation rather than a personal name.
